descriptor.name: Hessen simplified ALKIS cadastral parcels
descriptor.operator: Hessisches Landesamt für Bodenmanagement und Geoinformation
descriptor.scope: State ALKIS cadastral parcels; frozen bounded Wiesbaden samples. Citywide completeness is unverified.

evidence: Official Hessen WFS GetCapabilities identifies WFS HE ALKIS Vereinfacht and states: Das Liegenschaftskataster wird in elektronischer Form im Amtlichen Liegenschaftskatasterinformationssystem (ALKIS) geführt. The service lists cadastral Flurstücke and exposes ave:Flurstueck. See evidence/official-service-inspection.json.

The frozen city packet identifies the Hessian state cadastral authority and reports Wiesbaden municipality attributes in the bounded ave:Flurstueck response near the unchanged WUP locator. Its safe native oid sample polygons DEHE062000013CfcFL and DEHE062000013CfdFL are retained in the frozen sample input, whose expected SHA-256 is verified. This establishes bounded Wiesbaden parcel evidence, without a citywide coverage claim.
